subject.title: feat: unify Claude Code / Codex session catalogs into native session UX

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this generic public session-catalog API and expose catalogs independently of Codex supervision tools once shipped UX parity and live proof are restored?
rationale: The branch changes the public Plugin SDK and Gateway contract and deliberately redefines the existing Codex supervision opt-in boundary; code review cannot choose those permanent product semantics without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve after parity repairs
options.body: Adopt the generic native catalog after pagination, error visibility, generated-client completeness, and real-binary proof are added.

options.title: Retain provider-owned catalogs
options.body: Keep the current provider-specific surfaces until a smaller separately approved generic catalog design is available.

recommendation.title: Approve after parity repairs
recommendation.body: Adopt the generic native catalog after pagination, error visibility, generated-client completeness, and real-binary proof are added.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked issue and merged Codex and Claude catalog history make steipete the clearest available owner for this product and API decision.
